appearance_section.imageFormats: JPEG · PNG · WebP · GIF · AVIF — max 10 MB
appearance_section.autoThemeDesc: Switches theme automatically based on sun.sun (sunrise/sunset).

performance_section.fpsDescription: Measures browser rendering FPS in real time to diagnose slowdowns.
performance_section.intro: Disable costly visual effects to improve performance on tablets and small devices.
performance_section.reduceBlurDesc: Reduces backdrop-filter from 20–40px to 4px on all cards.
performance_section.disableModalAnimationDesc: Replaces the card-opening animation with a simple fade.

sound_section.intro: Sound feedback plays short tones when you interact with widgets.
sound_section.enabledDesc: Play sounds on toggle, slider, button press, etc.

system_section.ingressDesc: Use this URL to open the dashboard without the Home Assistant sidebar (wall display, WallPanel, kiosk mode).
system_section.ingressNotAvailable: Only available when running as a Home Assistant add-on.
system_section.configExportDesc: Generate a text string containing your entire configuration (theme, layout, widgets). Save it or share it to restore later.
system_section.configImportDesc: Paste a previously exported config string to restore all settings.
system_section.configImportConfirm: This will overwrite your current configuration. Click Import again to confirm.
system_section.configImportErrPrefix: Invalid string — must start with HADASH1:
system_section.configImportErrJson: Invalid string — could not parse content.
system_section.configImportErrMissing: Incomplete config — theme or dashboard data is missing.

language_section.overridesDescription: Override specific translation keys with your own text.

sound_section.intro: Play a short sound effect when you interact with widgets (toggle, buttons, sliders…).
sound_section.enabledDesc: Plays a tone when you tap a card or change a setting.

layout_section.rowHeightDesc: Height of each grid row (in px).
